description: This is a unit test class for the EmailQueueDao component within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing email queue operations such as retrieving, saving, removing emails, and fetching pending email IDs. The class extends KernelTestCase and employs mock services and fixture data for testing database interactions.

classes.name: EmailQueueDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the EmailQueueDao's email queue operations within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case, creating an instance of EmailQueueDao and populating fixture data.

methods.name: testGetEmail
methods.description: Tests retrieval of an email by ID from the queue and validates its subject and body.

methods.name: testSaveEmail
methods.description: Tests saving a new email to the queue and verifies the stored email's properties.

methods.name: testRemoveFromQueue
methods.description: Tests removal of emails from the queue by ID and checks the number of records affected.

methods.name: testAllPendingMailIds
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of all pending email IDs in the queue.
